international.canonicalTopic: UK regional leaders' memorandum on constitutional change
international.headline: UK regional leaders call for constitutional changes based on self-determination
facts: Scotland’s John Swinney, Wales’s Rhun ap Iorwerth and Northern Ireland’s Michelle O’Neill met in Cardiff on September 14, 2026, and signed a joint memorandum calling for constitutional changes based on self-determination.
They called for people in their regions to determine their constitutional futures and for closer relations with the European Union.
Under the 1998 Good Friday Agreement, Northern Ireland has a specific mechanism for a border poll; Scotland and Wales cannot unilaterally hold legally binding independence referendums.
In Scotland’s 2014 independence referendum, 55% voted to remain in the United Kingdom and 45% voted for independence.
international.summary: The three regional leaders’ memorandum raised questions about self-determination and the constitutional arrangements governing referendums in the United Kingdom.
international.staticLink: Good Friday Agreement 1998; United Kingdom’s constituent countries; constitutional devolution.
international.prelimsTakeaway: The Good Friday Agreement provides a specific border-poll mechanism for Northern Ireland; Scotland and Wales cannot unilaterally hold legally binding independence referendums.
international.mainsAngle: Compare constitutional devolution and the legal processes for self-determination within a unitary or devolved state.

national.canonicalTopic: Department of Financial Services receives Rajbhasha Kirti Award
national.headline: Financial Services Department wins first prize in 2025–26 Rajbhasha Kirti Awards
facts: The Department of Financial Services received the First Prize in the 2025–26 Rajbhasha Kirti Awards in the category for Ministries/Departments with fewer than 300 employees.
The award recognised performance and innovative work in implementing Official Language Hindi.
The award was presented at the 6th All India Official Language Conference and Hindi Diwas programme at the CIDCO Exhibition Centre, Vashi, Navi Mumbai, on September 14–15, 2026.
The award is presented by the Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs.
Article 343 provides for Hindi in the Devanagari script as the Official Language of the Union; Hindi Diwas marks the Constituent Assembly’s adoption of Hindi on September 14, 1949.
national.summary: The Department of Financial Services received the 2025–26 Rajbhasha Kirti Award’s First Prize for its work promoting the Union’s Official Language Hindi.
national.staticLink: Article 343 concerns the Official Language of the Union.
national.prelimsTakeaway: The award was presented by the Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs, during the 6th All India Official Language Conference in Vashi.
national.mainsAngle: Use of official languages in public administration and government communication.

national.headline: DARPG receives Rajbhasha Utkrishtata Samman 2025–26
facts: The Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) received the Rajbhasha Utkrishtata Samman 2025–26 on September 14, 2026, Hindi Diwas.
The Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs, presented the award for DARPG’s work implementing Official Language Hindi.

national.canonicalTopic: Supreme Court launches Jan Suchna Seva
national.headline: Supreme Court launches Jan Suchna Seva on Hindi Diwas
facts: The Supreme Court of India launched Jan Suchna Seva on September 14, 2026, Hindi Diwas, to make judicial services more inclusive and improve public access to the judiciary.
The service offers selected judgments and orders with their subsequent legal implications in concise, accessible formats.
It also provides 15–30 minute audio-visual explanations of lengthy and complex legal documents.
The Supreme Court was established on January 28, 1950, under Article 124.
national.summary: The Supreme Court introduced Jan Suchna Seva to present selected judicial decisions and their implications in accessible text and audio-visual formats.
national.staticLink: Article 124 concerns the establishment of the Supreme Court of India.
national.prelimsTakeaway: Jan Suchna Seva launched on Hindi Diwas, September 14, 2026, and includes 15–30 minute audio-visual explanations.
national.mainsAngle: Accessible legal information can strengthen public understanding of court decisions and the justice system.

national.headline: Indian Air Force holds Dronathon 2026 at Pokhran
facts: Vice Chief of the Air Staff Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit inaugurated the three-day Dronathon at Pokhran Field Firing Range, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan.
The event ran from 14 to 16 September 2026 and enabled engagement with India’s indigenous unmanned-systems industry.
More than 20 defence companies, startups, MSMEs, Defence Public Sector Undertakings and innovators participated.
The event tested emerging technologies under operational conditions.
national.summary: The Air Force event brought together public and private sector participants to demonstrate and test emerging unmanned systems.
national.staticLink: Pokhran Field Firing Range is in Jaisalmer district, Rajasthan.
national.prelimsTakeaway: Inaugurated by Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit; location: Pokhran Field Firing Range; dates: 14–16 September 2026.
national.mainsAngle: Operational trials and collaboration with startups and industry can support development of indigenous unmanned systems.
